newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Rail prices steady to lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Rail prices steady to lower.

text.p: U.S. cash rail soymeal prices were steady to lower Wednesday, weighed down by slackened demand in several locations, soymeal brokers said.
One dealer said recent warm weather in the Southeast will prompt some livestock producers to put animals on pastures, which would reduce demand for soymeal.
"The market is kind of quiet. We are seeing a little bit of trade in the domestic market," a second dealer said.
He also noted the market had a relatively good amount of export business. But he said he expects a slowdown in activity as the harvest of Brazil's soybean crop begins.
Meanwhile, surging demand from China and low domestic consumption will keep Indian soymeal exports in 1996/97 at last year's levels despite a lower crop forecast, Indian exporters said.
